name: X (Twitter)
summary: Collects public X (Twitter) profiles and recent posts for account nodes. Desktop only.
description:
Anonymous collection from X (Twitter): the public profile and recent posts of accounts already in the graph, read through the logged-out guest path the X web app itself uses (the same one the Fritter and Squawker clients use), with no API key and no login. The two plugins are separate on purpose: a profile is one node, a timeline can be a hundred posts with their hashtags and media, and the two fail independently.

## Plugins

Both run on Social Account (`social.account`) and Account (`identity.account`) nodes and query X by the node's `username`, or its `handle` when there is no username. A node with neither is skipped and counted in the run summary.

### X Profile

`run.vineyard.plugins.x_profile`

- **Adds:** writes the profile to the X Social Account node for that username (platform `x`), creating it if absent: `user_id`, `display_name`, `bio`, `location`, `website`, `followers`, `following`, `post_count`, `verified`, `created_date` (the join date), `profile_url` and `avatar_url`.
- A suspended, unavailable or unknown account is skipped and counted as an X error in the run summary; the rest of the selection still runs.
- Run it first: it records `user_id`, and X Posts then skips the profile lookup for that node.

### X Posts

`run.vineyard.plugins.x_posts`

- **Adds:** one Post node (`social.post`) per post, with its text, time, language, like, repost and reply counts, conversation id, permalink (`https://x.com/<user>/status/<id>`) and media URLs; Hashtag (`social.hashtag`) and Media (`social.media`) nodes; and the edges `posted by` (from the account to each post), `uses hashtag`, `contains media`, `reposted` and `replies to`.
- A repost is linked to its original, which X embeds in the timeline. A reply is linked only when the post it answers is in the same collection. Mentions are not turned into nodes.
- If the selected node has no `user_id`, the profile is looked up first, and the X Social Account node the posts attach to is created or filled in.
- **Parameter:** `count`, the most posts to collect per account, 1 to 100, default 20. X chooses its own page size, so the plugin follows the timeline page by page and stops at `count`, at the end of the timeline, on a page that adds nothing new, or after 10 pages. When it falls short of `count`, the run summary says so.
- X's media types are mapped onto the Social type pack's `media_type` values (`photo` to `image`, `animated_gif` to `gif`, `video` to `video`); anything else becomes `unknown`.
- **Unreliable for some accounts.** For some accounts X returns an empty timeline over this path although the profile loads and a logged-out browser shows the posts. It is not the account being private. It happens more often for smaller accounts, roughly under a thousand followers, but that is a tendency and not a threshold, and nothing on the account or in the plugin changes it. X Profile is reliable; treat X Posts as best effort.

## Requirements

- **Desktop app only.** X sends no CORS headers and answers no CORS preflight, so a browser cannot reach these endpoints. The Run plugins dialog offers to allow `https://api.twitter.com` and `https://twitter.com` in one click, and the desktop app asks to confirm each origin. In the web app the plugins say to open the project in the desktop app.
- No API key, login or OAuth. Requests carry the public bearer token the X web app serves to every anonymous visitor inside its own JavaScript (a client identifier that belongs to no account, not a credential) and a guest token minted for the run.
- No Vineyard-operated service is involved.

## Cost and limits

- Each plugin mints one guest token per run, so running both costs one extra activation. X Profile then makes one request per account; X Posts makes up to 10 timeline requests per account, plus a profile request when the node has no `user_id`.
- Requests are paced like a person reading: a jittered pause of 0.7 to 2 seconds before every request, and a longer pause of 1.5 to 4 seconds every 8th request. A 429 waits for `Retry-After`, or backs off exponentially up to 30 seconds. A request is tried at most 5 times. The run can be cancelled at every pause.
- If X rejects the guest token (401 or 403), the session is re-activated and the request retried; when X's rate-limit headers show the token is spent, it is renewed before the next request.
- At most 100 posts per account per run. That is a review budget, not an X limit: 100 posts with their hashtags, media and thread links are already a few hundred items to review.

## What it contacts

- Only X: api.twitter.com, to start the guest session, and twitter.com, for the profile and timeline queries (the web app's own GraphQL operations `UserByScreenName` and `UserTweets`).
- X sees every username queried, from the analyst's network address, and can rate-limit or block that address.
- Read only: nothing is posted, followed or liked.

## Caveats

- X rotates its internal GraphQL operation ids and gates the guest path whenever it chooses. Expect breakage, and expect a new version of this pack when it happens.
- Anonymous collection is a terms-of-service grey area.
- A protected (private) account gives no usable timeline; the run reports that rather than creating empty posts.
- When X answers with its bot-check page instead of data, the run says so. Wait and run again; if it persists, X is gating the anonymous path for that network.

## Data and licences

Profiles and posts are X's public data, as X returns it to a logged-out visitor. The nodes use the Social Media type pack (`run.vineyard.typepacks.social`); attributing an account to a person or organization is left to the Identity type pack.

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-x (Apache-2.0)

`dist/pack.mjs` is built from `src/` with a pinned esbuild, so the published bundle can be checked against the source: `node build.mjs && git diff --exit-code dist/pack.mjs`.

plugins.name: X Profile
plugins.description: Fetches the public X (Twitter) profile for each selected Social Account or Account node's username and writes it to the X Social Account node (created if absent): user_id, display name, bio, location, website, follower/following/post counts, verification, join date, avatar URL. Desktop only.

network.purpose: Start a logged-out guest session on X.
Read public data of the selected accounts from X.

plugins.name: X Posts
plugins.description: Collects recent X (Twitter) posts for each selected Social Account or Account node's username. Creates one Post node per post (text, time, language, engagement counts, permalink, media URLs) plus Hashtag and Media nodes, with "posted by", "uses hashtag", "contains media", "reposted" and "replies to" edges; if the selected node has no user_id, also creates or fills the X Social Account node the posts attach to. Up to count posts per account (default 20, max 100); some accounts return an empty timeline even though their posts are public. Desktop only.
